skill.summary: Generate 15 optimized YouTube thumbnail text options with CTR scores, color schemes, fonts, and size guidelines tailored to your video topic and niche.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI YouTube Thumbnail Text Generator.

- Instantly generate 15 CTR-optimized thumbnail text options per video topic.
- Each option includes CTR prediction score, color scheme, font, and size recommendations.
- Analyzes viral thumbnails in your niche to inform style suggestions.
- Provides emotional triggers, trending styles, and revenue potential predictions.
- Full workflow and quick start guide included for easy use by creators and brands.
